items.title: 镜筒式层叠缩放叙事

historicalCapture.caveat: Distinct JPEG hashes are capture evidence; they are not the encoded visual frame rate.

sampling.frames: all decoded frames, original integer PTS; copyts and fps_mode passthrough; no fps filter or frame selection

decodedAnalysis.interpretation: Offline decoded source-media RGB changes. Same dimensions and threshold as the browser probe; FFmpeg color conversion and bilinear scaling are not claimed pixel-identical to browser canvas. These are not observed screen frames or browser playback rates.

integrity.originalPtsMatchRule: Exact PTS multiset including duplicates; frameTimeline retains original decoder order and unmodified frame PTS.

decodedAnalysis.presentationDurationSource: Original [PTS,nextPTS) intervals clipped to the explicit stream start_pts + duration_ts end. All original frames retained; duplicate PTS and at/after-end frames have zero presentation duration. No nominal-FPS inference or extension of the playback window.
decodedAnalysis.changeMetricTimeline: Original-PTS-sorted positive-duration presentation frames; same-PTS group retains its last decoded frame. Raw frameTimeline and transitions retain original decoder order and every unmodified PTS, including zero-duration and out-of-window frames.
decodedAnalysis.presentationOrderRule: Complete original frame-index permutation sorted by unmodified original PTS, then decoder index; no frame removal.

decodedAnalysis.interpretation: Offline decoded source-media RGB changes. Same dimensions and threshold as the browser probe; FFmpeg color conversion and bilinear scaling are not claimed pixel-identical to browser canvas. These are not observed screen frames or browser playback rates.

integrity.originalPtsMatchRule: Exact PTS multiset including duplicates; frameTimeline retains original decoder order and unmodified frame PTS.

decodedAnalysis.presentationDurationSource: Original [PTS,nextPTS) intervals clipped to the explicit stream start_pts + duration_ts end. All original frames retained; duplicate PTS and at/after-end frames have zero presentation duration. No nominal-FPS inference or extension of the playback window.
decodedAnalysis.changeMetricTimeline: Original-PTS-sorted positive-duration presentation frames; same-PTS group retains its last decoded frame. Raw frameTimeline and transitions retain original decoder order and every unmodified PTS, including zero-duration and out-of-window frames.
decodedAnalysis.presentationOrderRule: Complete original frame-index permutation sorted by unmodified original PTS, then decoder index; no frame removal.
